There's just no logical way the show can have a coherent plot without significant cuts to and rearranging of the story. The books contain '''4,410,036''' words. By necessity, the show will depart significantly from the novels, and many of the pages prominently contain major spoilers right at the top. As complicated as the story and setting are, there will be a huge influx of new users trying to understand what they've just watched, and as soon as they look up any names, they're going to be spoiled severely. The only solution I see to this is a separate wiki. Now, if as you say, there is a policy against "duplicate" wikis, then I think the only way past this impass is starting a new TV show-only wiki on a different platform. I personally would prefer to have the show wiki on the same platform for possible cross-referencing purposes, but that small conceit isn't worth the headache of trying to make every page jive between both versions, that will be a nightmare.

For reference, I've been the one doing most of the updates on the show-related pages for the past several months.
